## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link related issues.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results. State skips and missing dependencies.
For performance or visual changes, attach measurements or screenshots.

- [ ] `make check` passes.
- [ ] Relevant regression/integration checks pass.
- [ ] Documentation and generated references match the change.
- [ ] Generated binaries, dependencies and machine-specific reports are excluded.
